# bayespk

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/DaikiKumakura/bayespk/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DaikiKumakura/bayespk/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![R-universe](https://daikikumakura.r-universe.dev/badges/bayespk)](https://daikikumakura.r-universe.dev/bayespk)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.24325845.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24325845)

Bayesian population pharmacokinetics in R **without writing Stan**.

## Installation

From R-universe (binaries for Windows, macOS and Linux):

``` r

install.packages("bayespk", repos = c("https://daikikumakura.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(bayespk)

mod <- pk_model("1cmt", route = "oral", iiv = c("CL", "V", "KA"), error = "proportional")
fit <- bpk_fit(mod, bpk_example, chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1)   # 30 simulated subjects
summary(fit)

plot(fit)   # individual fits
```

## Validation and limitations

- **Validation:** Compared closed-form PK with rxode2, ran
  simulation-based calibration, and compared fits on public theophylline
  and warfarin data.
- **Results:** The concentration checks agreed within 1e-8 relative
  error; typical parameter estimates differed from FOCEI by about 1–10%.
- **Limitations:** Sparse oral two-compartment fits can mix slowly. The
  log-error and censoring scenario showed a small rank imbalance.
- **Reproduction:**
  [inst/validation/README.md](https://github.com/DaikiKumakura/bayespk/blob/main/inst/validation/README.md).

# Package index

## Model

- [`pk_model()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/pk_model.md)
  : Define a population pharmacokinetic model
- [`pk_priors()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/pk_priors.md)
  : Specify priors
- [`lognormal()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/priors.md)
  [`normal()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/priors.md)
  [`half_normal()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/priors.md)
  : Prior distributions

## Fit and results

- [`bpk_fit()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/bpk_fit.md)
  : Fit a Bayesian population pharmacokinetic model
- [`summary(`*`<bpk_fit>`*`)`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/summary.bpk_fit.md)
  : Summarise a fit
- [`predict(`*`<bpk_fit>`*`)`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/predict.bpk_fit.md)
  : Posterior predictions
- [`plot(`*`<bpk_fit>`*`)`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/plot.bpk_fit.md)
  : Plot a fit
- [`plot(`*`<bpk_prediction>`*`)`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/plot.bpk_prediction.md)
  : Plot predictions
- [`bpk_draws()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/bpk_draws.md)
  : Posterior draws of population parameters
- [`bpk_diagnostics()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/bpk_diagnostics.md)
  : Sampler diagnostics
- [`prior_sensitivity()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/prior_sensitivity.md)
  : Prior sensitivity by power-scaling

## Concentrations and regimens

- [`pk_conc()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/pk_conc.md)
  : Concentrations from closed-form solutions
- [`dose_regimen()`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/dose_regimen.md)
  : Dosing regimen

## Data

- [`bpk_example`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/bpk_example.md)
  : Simulated oral pharmacokinetic data

## Package

- [`bayespk-package`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/bayespk-package.md)
  [`bayespk`](https://daikikumakura.github.io/bayespk/reference/bayespk-package.md)
  : bayespk: Bayesian population pharmacokinetics without writing Stan
